Description: Ready to level up your next branding project? Here’s how graphic designer @valeriakokur turns images into perfectly on-brand visuals for brand guidelines with #AdobeStock’s AI Studio! 🙌  

This tutorial will cover how to:  

- Match image colors to your exact brand palette  

- Expand images to fit your desired layout and aspect ratio  

- Edit multiple images at once with Bulk Edit  

- Create a consistent visual style across your brand guidelines  

If you’re working on a brand identity, mood board, presentation, or social media campaign, try Adobe Stock’s AI Studio to experiment and create assets that match your creative vision and feel cohesive! https://adobe.ly/3SKZ8DI

description: Customer feedback helps us prioritize our roadmap, so we’re shipping features that make a difference in how you create. For our passionate crew of After Effects pros, we heard you loud and clear: you want 3D outputs that are more realistic and immersive. That’s why we introduced new depth of field capabilities, with controls for Focus Distance, Aperture, and Blur. Have you tried them out? Let us know in the comments!
title: Explore the depths of After Effects 🪏 with these 3D depth of field controls #shorts
